leader_opinions.title:
Also one more filter for today:

🔲 Public company
☑️ Privately owned
🔲 Government owned

I love ETFs as much as the next
leader_opinions.title_en:
Also one more filter for today:

🔲 Public company
☑️ Privately owned
🔲 Government owned

I love ETFs as much as the next guy but they do put a pressure on stocks to grow by 10%/year or more

Hotels have a hard time doing that, so how do you grow? You cut costs and big hotel chains have been doing that in the name of DEI and ESG and wokeness a lot. Locking down ACs, no daily cleaning, cutting corners, etc. it all saves money

Those cost savings mean higer profit margins mean growth!

Great as an ETF or stock holder, terrible as a hotel guest

So you can now filter on privately owned

One of the most consistent quality hotel chains I visit is Four Seasons (recommended by many people on here), not cheap, but almost always a good experience

Guess who owns Four Seasons? It's private! And it's @billgates and @Alwaleed_Talal

They must have a had such terrible hotel experiences, they had to buy their own hotel to get a good one! Can you imagine? 😂

leader_opinions.title:
When possible, we want to give people a choice—and be clear about what watermarking can and can’t do.

A text watermark
leader_opinions.title_en:
When possible, we want to give people a choice—and be clear about what watermarking can and can’t do.

A text watermark helps answer one question: “Was this likely generated by an OpenAI model?”

It works by embedding an invisible statistical signal in text as it’s generated. A detector can look for this signal, and it doesn’t add visible marks or special characters. It doesn’t say who originally wrote the text or who owns it. It doesn’t identify a person, organization, account, conversation, or prompt.

In our testing, watermarking hasn’t affected how capable or fast our models are, or how their responses read.

leader_opinions.title: We're expanding our approach to content provenance to include text in response to EU regulatory requirements, while reco
leader_opinions.title_en:
We're expanding our approach to content provenance to include text in response to EU regulatory requirements, while recognizing the significant limitations of current text watermarking technology.

Our tools already help verify whether an image or audio file was created with our models. This work builds on those efforts to help people better understand when content may have been generated or edited with an OpenAI model.

In the EU, we’ll start watermarking eligible text from ChatGPT and Codex over the coming weeks to comply with the EU AI Act.

Customers using our API can turn on text watermarking for select models worldwide today.

items.title: What is the probability that Astra today can generate/forecast a particular new paper past its cutoff date? Naive sampli
items.title_en:
What is the probability that Astra today can generate/forecast a particular new paper past its cutoff date? Naive sampling is intractable (tail probability is astronomically small).

The key idea of priced guidance is that you can lower bound this probability via a dialogue between the model (Astra) and a guide LLM (Astra with the paper), where we can precisely account for the bits of information sent from the guide to the model. One can also can think of this as a new eval for frontier models.

We’re also opening up new tiers to allow for authorized offensive work, like penetration testing and red-teaming.

items.title: There's a reason I've been porting so many classic games I liked to web with WASM and why this is taking off now I think
items.title_en:
There's a reason I've been porting so many classic games I liked to web with WASM and why this is taking off now I think

Because it's way easier to just open a new tab, type the URL and start playing than...

Switching on a console or gaming PC, waiting for it to boot, installing the Xbox/PS/Windows/Steam updates, rebooting, finding the game in your library, then a game popup appears (new DLC!!!), click away popup, click [ PLAY ], game has to download the new 50GB updates for 30 minutes, wait, load game, takes ages, tap [ Online ], try find our friends in some convoluted way, [ Play ]

I think game and console developers do not realize people don't have time to do all this

Many of us are doing other stuff, then have a break, just want to jump into a game, play a bit with friends, and get out again! And decompiling games and porting them to WASM does exactly that!

Many of us are doing other stuff, then have a break, just want to jump into a game, play a bit with friends, and get out again! And decompiling games and porting them to WASM does exactly that!

SGLang has Day-0 support for EmbeddingGemma 2 from @GoogleDeepMind!

EmbeddingGemma 2 is a multimodal embedding model. It maps text, code, images, video, and audio into one shared 768d embedding space.
- 4 modalities with interleaved inputs, 8K context, 100+ languages
- Flexible footprint: modular encoders from 270M (text-only) to 740M (all modalities), plus Matryoshka embeddings

Get started with SGLang

At 740M parameters, it’s competitive across benchmarks – even outperforming some specialist models more than twice its size.

Developers can use it to add multimodal search to their apps – like finding moments in a video using a voice memo – or pair it with Gemma 4 for private, on-device RAG.

EmbeddingGemma 2 is released under an Apache 2.0 license. Check out the weights on @HuggingFace and @Kaggle.

Find out more → https://t.co/lRsjbvR5VB

Introducing the @Every Agent—an agentic coworker in Slack built to help you AI-pill your company.

It comes
items.title_en:
BREAKING: 

Introducing the @Every Agent—an agentic coworker in Slack built to help you AI-pill your company.

It comes with:
- Everything you'd expect from a premium company agent. You can delegate difficult, long-running—like opening PRs, writing reports from large datasets, and monitoring social or customer feedback—and get high-quality results all from Slack
- Every's best workflows, pre-installed and always updated. Compound Engineering to Compound Writing. We add more all the time. 
- Personalized Frontier Alerts. to help you keep up with new models. When we drop a Vibe Check, the Every Agent will read it and let you know if the new model is relevant to your workflow.
- Zero markup on tokens. What we pay is what you pay—as token prices go down, so does your bill.

You can try it today with $15 in free credits per person, up to $500 per workspace. 

After that: it comes with your $30/month Every subscription, plus tokens at cost.

Add the Every Agent to Slack: https://t.co/L7ergneERt

Why it's hard to AI-pill your coworkers
If you’re the AI-pilled one at work, you know the problem: you discover something incredible in Claude or Codex, but getting your coworkers to try it is another matter. 

The problem is that most of your AI use is invisible. You do it alone, in a terminal or a chat window. 

Your coworkers see the finished report or the five new ads, but they never see the request that produced them, or the corrections you made along the way. When you describe it afterward, it sounds like magic, but nobody learns a magic trick without seeing how it’s done.

Why a company agent, in Slack, solves this problem
When you use a company agent like the @every agent you go from prompting in private, to prompting in public. 

In a Slack channel, a coworker who would never open a terminal scrolls past a thread with your agent interaction and thinks: I could do that too.

This lets you show instead of tell your coworkers about your discoveries. New AI tools and workflows then spread naturally and virally across your organization.

That's why we made the @every agent for ourselves—and why we're releasing it to you today.

Add the Every Agent to Slack: https://t.co/L7ergneERt

items.title: We got Computer playing StarCraft against Computer, in real time. No pausing. The game keeps running while each agent th
items.title_en:
We got Computer playing StarCraft against Computer, in real time. No pausing. The game keeps running while each agent thinks.

Blue 2 – Red 5

Final match. Blue builds up safely, reaches 41 Dragoons, and moves out. Red is waiting with High Templar and hits the army with Psionic Storm. Blue hadn’t scouted what Red was building.

Computer assembled the whole setup: an OpenBW-based Brood War runtime on a VPS, a C++ bridge, and four gameplay tools per agent. Each agent receives its own fog-of-war-limited game state. Recording and camera control run separately; the agents aren’t given video input.
items.title_zh: 我们让电脑实时对战电脑玩星际争霸。没有停顿。当每个代理都在思考时，游戏继续运行。 蓝2 -红5 最后一场比赛。蓝军安全集结，到达41个龙骑兵，然后出发。瑞德带着圣堂武士在等待，然后用灵能S攻击军队

items.title: I'm excited to share our new film Delisted, about how we end up in 1984 without AI going rogue. It’s the 3rd dystopian A
items.title_en:
I'm excited to share our new film Delisted, about how we end up in 1984 without AI going rogue. It’s the 3rd dystopian AI scenario that we need to avoid to enjoy AI's great upside:
1) Rogue AI
2) Obedient AI misused
3) Obedient AI causes 1984
4) Race-to-replace by obedient AI
Synopsis: When AI-driven power concentration sparks protests, the government's response isn't force - it's erasure. Dissenters are Delisted: wiped from every financial, digital and legal system.
Starring Katie Parker, Jamie Bamber, Alex Bhat, Rosalind Halstead, Charlie Hiscock, and Ruby Bridle.
Written & directed by Michael Patrick Clarkson
Featuring "Bleed Us Anew," an original song written and performed by Ruby Bridle
A Space Digital production, in collaboration with FLI
items.title_zh: 我很兴奋地分享我们的新电影《摘牌》，关于我们如何在1984年结束，没有人工智能的流氓。这是我们需要避免的第三种反乌托邦AI场景，以便享受AI的巨大优势： 1)流氓AI 2)听话的AI被滥用 3)顺从的AI引发了1984年 4)被顺从的人工智

items.title: Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having
items.title_en:
Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having the most intelligent model from outside the US and China

@MistralAI has released Mistral Large 4 in Research Public Preview, with plans to release the weights of the 1T parameter (49B active) model at the end of October. It achieves 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, comparable to GPT-6 Luna (max, 38) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39). It also achieves 50% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash and ahead of models such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max).

Key benchmarking results for Mistral Large 4 Preview:

➤ Most intelligent model from outside the US and China: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 38 on the Intelligence Index, comparable to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 38). This makes it the most intelligent model from outside the US and China, ahead of countries such as South Korea and the United Arab Emirates

➤ Level with GLM-5.3-Flash on cyber defense capability: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 50 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash (50) and behind MiMo-V2.6-Pro (56). Once its weights are released, it will rank among the top three open weights models on the Cyber Index. Its strongest result is on CyberGym-E2E-AA, where it scores 82%, ahead of MiMo-V2.6-Pro (79%) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 78%)

➤ Over 4x the Cost per Task of similar-intelligence open weights models: Mistral Large 4 Preview costs $1.13 per Intelligence Index task with standard pricing of $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens, with $0.14 per 1M cached input tokens. For the first two weeks, Mistral Large 4 Preview will be served at a 50% launch discount, bringing its Cost per Task down to $0.57. This is still more costly than GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.25) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, $0.27)

➤ Strong document and image reasoning: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 19% on GDP.pdf, on par with MiMo-V2.6-Pro (19%) and behind Kimi K3 (22%). This is an 18-point improvement from Mistral Large 3, partly driven by improvements in their API, which now accepts 100 images per request, up from 8 for previous Mistral models

Key model details:

➤ Context Window: 512k tokens

➤ Multimodality: Text and image input, with text output

➤ Pricing: $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.14 per 1M cached input tokens), with 50% off for the first two weeks ($0.68/$2.09)

➤ Availability: Research Public Preview on Mistral's API, with open weights planned for the end of October

items.title_en:
Researchers have now found extremely high amounts of PFAS in the majority of Dutch tap water

The Netherlands was long known for having some of the cleanest tap water in the world and every Dutch person would drink from it, but that turned out to be false

It's full of PFAS!

PFAS are per- and polyfluoroalkyl particles also known as "forever chemicals", they're highly toxic

They cause an endless list of body ailments like reducing fertility, disrupting your hormonal system, reduced testosterone levels, delayed fetal development, disrupting your immune system, causing cancer, elevating LDL cholestrol, and high blood pressure

And even worse maybe mind ailments like anxiety, depression, cognitive decline, ADHD and neurodegeneration

Sounds an awful lot like many of the mental ailments everyone in Netherlands is complaining about? A lot of people I know there are burnout, depressed, anxious and definitely low testosterone

@GreenpeaceNL lets every Dutch person check their tap water for PFAS

My friend did and his tap water is 2-3x over the limit!

I can recommend to all my Dutch friends to install an Reverse Osmosis water filter, it's the most rigorous filter out there and removes over 99% of PFAS and microplastics and other contaminants

I have a Waterdrop G3P600, as always I am not paid or affiliated, I wish I was cause I'd be rich

Did PFAS and a culture of drinking tap water make many Western Europeans weak men? I don't think it's too crazy of a thing to suggest actually!

items.title_en:
I first used Gamma in 2024.

A bunch of people in my cohort used it to upload their resumes and generate fully functional websites in a few seconds.

The new Gamma 5 looks much improved:

• It asks questions before building your deck
• It supports PowerPoint import and export
• Connectors to Notion, Slack, and HubSpot to import content
• Very easy to change the design/styles by prompting

This is the best app I've seen for turning any PDF/document into a website or presentation.

items.title_en:
Meet Mistral Large 4, aka Le Chonk. 

• 1T parameters, natively multimodal. 49B active.
It is the best open weights model from US or Europe on aggregated benchmarks.
• State-of-the-art on critical workloads, including cyber defense, manufacturing and finance and it surpasses closed frontier models on visual grounding.
• Forged in Europe end-to-end and is deployable from Europe via our own Mistral Cloud infrastructure.
• Available to all via API today. Working with cybersecurity partners privately.

Open weights release end of October.

items.title: Ling 3.1 Flash makes large gains in intelligence over its predecessor, scoring 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligenc
items.title_en:
Ling 3.1 Flash makes large gains in intelligence over its predecessor, scoring 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with particular improvement in agentic capabilities

@AntLingAGI has released Ling 3.1 Flash, a reasoning model with 560B total parameters, 25B active parameters, and a 1M token context window. It scores 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, up from 20 from Ling 3.0 Flash, which launched in August. Ling 3.1 Flash is expected to be open weights, with Ant Group releasing the weights soon.

Key results:

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash improves agentic capabilities over its predecessor. With a GDPval-AA v2 Elo of 1,622 and an AA-Briefcase Elo of 1,400, the model rivals peer models such as GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash (high) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max). Ling 3.1 Flash also shows notable gains on AutomationBench-AA (62%) and Terminal-Bench v4.0 (33%).

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash scores +2 on AA-Omniscience, a 22 point improvements from Ling 3.0 Flash (-18). Compared to its predecessor, its accuracy rate rose from 18% to 29% while the hallucination rate fell from 44% to 38% at a similar attempt rate (56% to 58%), demonstrating the gain comes primarily from knowing more, not abstaining more. For comparison, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max) has a hallucination rate of 97%.

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash is a larger model than its predecessor, priced accordingly, but more token efficient. It has 560B total and 25B active parameters, up from 124B and 5.1B for Ling 3.0 Flash, and is priced at $0.30 / $0.90 per 1M input / output tokens, up from $0.075 / $0.22. It used 218M output tokens to run the Intelligence Index, 16% fewer than Ling 3.0 Flash (261M).

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash has a higher cost per task than some peers, but remains in the most attractive quadrant. Ling 3.1 Flash costs $0.99 per task, well above GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.42) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max, $0.32) but below Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) at $1.24.

Additional model details:

➤ Size: 560B total parameters, 25B active

➤ Context window: 1M tokens

➤ Pricing: $0.30 per 1M input tokens and $0.90 per 1M output tokens, with cached input at $0.06 per 1M (80% discount)

➤ Availability: Accessible through Novita AI, with weights coming soon

items.title_en:
Airbnb just responded to "reviewgate"

The replies here are literally hundreds of people who got their reviews removed directly contradicting what Airbnb says here

The "policy" they have seems to be to remove a guest's review and rating whenever a host asks for it

I don't get why they don't just fix this? Everyone would love to see Airbnb have honest reviews and ratings you can trust

Short term you might get more bookings if everything is a 4.5 or 4.99 but long term people discover it means nothing and they can't trust your platform and they leave elsewhere

I think they're in some internal gridlock by MBAs who want to see revenue go up, not realizing that they're destroying a company

I hope they fix it!

items.title:
Day 2.1/

We have made Auto-review free for all users signed in through a ChatGPT account. You can enable it in settings
items.title_en:
Day 2.1/

We have made Auto-review free for all users signed in through a ChatGPT account. You can enable it in settings > permissions > auto-review. Auto-review improves upon the default sandbox setting that requires you to approve everything, which is prone to decision fatigue unless you spend a lot of time configuring specific rules.

It allows you to run long tasks while having a second agent review all actions taken by the primary agent. Its only goal is to prevent high-risk actions from being taken and to protect against unwanted actions that are not aligned with the original user intent. This  Auto-review feature is now free and does not draw usage from your plan.

items.title: OpenAI Web Search debuts on the Artificial Analysis Search Index at 74, the 5th best provider behind Perplexity, Octen,
items.title_en:
OpenAI Web Search debuts on the Artificial Analysis Search Index at 74, the 5th best provider behind Perplexity, Octen, Parallel and Brave

@OpenAI Web Search is the first integrated first-party search tool on our board. Instead of an agent calling a Search API in our Stirrup harness, GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning) calls OpenAI's built-in web_search tool, and OpenAI runs the whole search loop inside one Responses API call. All setups use the same underlying model, GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning).

At ~$0.05 per task, OpenAI Web Search costs less than Parallel (advanced, $0.06) and Perplexity (medium, $0.07), but about twice as much as Octen ($0.024), which scores 3 points higher.

Key benchmarking results for OpenAI Web Search (medium search context):

➤ 5th best provider on the Artificial Analysis Search Index: OpenAI Web Search scores 74, a 41-point lift over the same model with no search (33). It places 7th of 26 products, level with You . com (highlights), Nimble (standard) and Exa (auto) at 74, behind the three Perplexity variants (77 to 80), Octen (77), Parallel (advanced) and Brave (LLM context) at 75

➤ OpenAI Web Search performs best on AA-Omniscience, our proprietary factual answer benchmark, achieving 72% accuracy. This ranks 3rd of 26 search provider variants, within 1 point of the leader, Firecrawl (73%). BrowseComp, which needs multi-hop reasoning across several searches, is its weakest benchmark: at 73.5% it ranks 13th of 26, well behind the Perplexity variants and Octen (85% to 87%)

➤ OpenAI Web Search uses fewer tokens for the same tasks: OpenAI bills about 40k input tokens per task, search results included, against 125k for the leanest Search API on the board, Perplexity (low). Its model cost is among the lowest on the board, at about $0.009 per task

➤ Built-in search costs less per task than most Search APIs: At ~$0.05 per task, OpenAI Web Search is cheaper than 17 of the 25 Search API products on the board (median $0.067), including Parallel (advanced, $0.06) and Perplexity (medium, $0.07). Octen costs about half as much ($0.024) and scores 3 points higher

Key details:

➤ Setup: GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning) with OpenAI's web_search tool and search_context_size set to medium, in one Responses API call

➤ Pricing: $10 per 1k web_search calls, plus the search content, which OpenAI bills as model input tokens

➤ Contamination: we block known contamination sources through the tool's domain filter

items.title: ElevenLabs' Eleven v4 Turbo takes the #1 spot on the Artificial Analysis Provider Voice TTS Arena Leaderboard, ahead of
items.title_en:
ElevenLabs' Eleven v4 Turbo takes the #1 spot on the Artificial Analysis Provider Voice TTS Arena Leaderboard, ahead of Eleven v4 while costing half the price

Eleven v4 Turbo is the faster, lower-cost sibling of Eleven v4 from @ElevenLabs, designed to deliver comparable speech quality with lower latency and cost.

Key takeaways:

➤ Provider Voice: Eleven v4 Turbo has an Elo of 1,334 (+19/-19) across 1,645 appearances, placing it ahead of Eleven v4 at 1,321, Alibaba's Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus at 1,292 and Cartesia's Sonic 3.6 at 1,278. It ranks #1 in Customer Service and Entertainment and #2 in Assistants and Knowledge Sharing.

➤ Controlled Voice: Eleven v4 Turbo ranks #2 with an Elo of 1,173 (+15/-15) across 1,745 appearances, behind Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus at 1,181 and ahead of Eleven v4 at 1,160. It ranks #1 in Arabic, German, Hindi and English (UK).

➤ Pronunciation Robustness: Eleven v4 Turbo scores 90.1%, ranking #2 behind Eleven v4 at 91.7% and ahead of Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS at 89.5%.

➤ Pricing: Eleven v4 Turbo is priced at $40/1M characters, half the price of Eleven v4 at $80/1M characters, compared to Sonic 3.6 at $49/1M characters and Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS at $16.49/1M characters.

➤ Speed: Eleven v4 Turbo processes 96 characters per second of generation time, compared to 84 characters per second for Eleven v4 and 59 for Eleven v3.

See more details and listen to samples below 🧵

Also one more filter for today:

🔲 Public company
☑️ Privately owned
🔲 Government owned

I love ETFs as much as the next
items.title_en:
Also one more filter for today:

🔲 Public company
☑️ Privately owned
🔲 Government owned

I love ETFs as much as the next guy but they do put a pressure on stocks to grow by 10%/year or more

Hotels have a hard time doing that, so how do you grow? You cut costs and big hotel chains have been doing that in the name of DEI and ESG and wokeness a lot. Locking down ACs, no daily cleaning, cutting corners, etc. it all saves money

Those cost savings mean higer profit margins mean growth!

Great as an ETF or stock holder, terrible as a hotel guest

So you can now filter on privately owned

One of the most consistent quality hotel chains I visit is Four Seasons (recommended by many people on here), not cheap, but almost always a good experience

Guess who owns Four Seasons? It's private! And it's @billgates and @Alwaleed_Talal

They must have a had such terrible hotel experiences, they had to buy their own hotel to get a good one! Can you imagine? 😂

items.title: Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late
items.title_en: Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late
items.author: The Verge AI
items.article_content:
Google may be expanding its "Call for Me" AI feature beyond business calls so you can use it to send messages to friends and family. Android Authority reports finding a "Gemini Calling" introductory screen in an APK teardown with examples that include "Call Mom and tell her I will be 15 minutes late" and "Call John and ask if he is coming for dinner."

Based on those examples, even with this expansion, Gemini would likely be limited to basic, text message-like calls. While Google's AI might not automate an entire catch-up phone call with your relatives, it could deliver quick messages to people who prefer a phone call, miss texts often, or  …

items.article_content_zh:
b谷歌可能会将其“呼叫我”的人工智能功能扩展到商务电话之外，这样你就可以用它给朋友和家人发信息了。Android权威报告称，在APK拆解中发现了一个“Gemini Calling”的介绍屏幕，其中的例子包括“打电话给妈妈，告诉她我会的”

基于这些例子，即使有了这样的扩展，双子座也可能仅限于基本的、类似短信的电话。虽然b谷歌的人工智能可能不会自动完成与亲戚的整个电话通话，但它可以向喜欢打电话的人发送快速消息，tex小姐

items.title_en: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
items.author: Ars Technica
items.article_content:
The adoption of AI agents in millions of organizations is creating new opportunities for attackers to make them take malicious actions, such as exfiltrating database contents and sensitive business and personal information.

In the past five months, Google and four other organizations—with little in common except for their use of AI agents—have acknowledged vulnerabilities that exploit one agent inside a targeted network to spread harmful instructions to other internal agents. The technique is a special form of prompt injection that targets not the LLM but a particular agent, such as one for translation or data analysis. Guardrails inside such agents, if they exist at all, are often lax and will send the instructions to other agents down the chain. Because the latter agent explicitly trusts the first one, it follows the directions.

Independent researcher Syed Anas Mohiuddin tested agents from organizations including Google, JP Morgan Chase, Weviate, Rapid7, the French government's interministerial digital directorate, and the US federal government. items.title: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
items.title_en: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
items.author: The Verge AI
items.article_content:
This past year, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other labs have announced breakthroughs on numerous long-standing mathematical problems, in some cases pushing well beyond what researchers expected current systems to be capable of — including resolving one of the famous Millennium Prize problems. But in classic Silicon Valley style, AI labs are moving fast and breaking things, barreling through the discipline with all the grace of a runaway bulldozer. Results that might normally have been celebrated have instead sparked backlash. AI labs say they are learning from earlier mistakes. Whether those promises bear fruit remains to be seen.

items.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
items.title_en: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
items.author: THE DECODER
items.article_content:
Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk.

items.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
items.title_en: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
items.author: THE DECODER
items.article_content:
Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window.

The article Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
items.title_en: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
items.author: The Verge AI
items.article_content:
An invisible, machine-readable watermark in text output is rolling out to ChatGPT and Codex, but only for users in the European Union at first.

OpenAI says its textGrain watermarking "matched or exceeded" other approaches like Google DeepMind's SynthID for text, which is also the basis for the watermarking Anthropic announced in August. Like OpenAI, Anthropic made the move to meet the requirements of the EU's AI Act; however, not everyone was happy to learn about the addition.

items.title:
When possible, we want to give people a choice—and be clear about what watermarking can and can’t do.

A text watermark
items.title_en:
When possible, we want to give people a choice—and be clear about what watermarking can and can’t do.

A text watermark helps answer one question: “Was this likely generated by an OpenAI model?”

It works by embedding an invisible statistical signal in text as it’s generated. A detector can look for this signal, and it doesn’t add visible marks or special characters. It doesn’t say who originally wrote the text or who owns it. It doesn’t identify a person, organization, account, conversation, or prompt.

In our testing, watermarking hasn’t affected how capable or fast our models are, or how their responses read.
items.title_zh: 如果可能的话，我们希望给人们一个选择，并明确水印可以做什么和不能做什么。 文本水印有助于回答一个问题：“这可能是由 OpenAI 模型生成的吗？” 它的工作原理是在生成的文本中嵌入不可见的统计信号。探测器可以寻找该信号，并且不会添加可见

When possible, we want to give people a choice—and be clear about what watermarking can and can’t do.

A text watermark helps answer one question: “Was this likely generated by an OpenAI model?”

It works by embedding an invisible statistical signal in text as it’s generated. A detector can look for this signal, and it doesn’t add visible marks or special characters. It doesn’t say who originally wrote the text or who owns it. It doesn’t identify a person, organization, account, conversation, or prompt.

In our testing, watermarking hasn’t affected how capable or fast our models are, or how their responses read.

items.title: We're expanding our approach to content provenance to include text in response to EU regulatory requirements, while reco
items.title_en:
We're expanding our approach to content provenance to include text in response to EU regulatory requirements, while recognizing the significant limitations of current text watermarking technology.

Our tools already help verify whether an image or audio file was created with our models. This work builds on those efforts to help people better understand when content may have been generated or edited with an OpenAI model.

In the EU, we’ll start watermarking eligible text from ChatGPT and Codex over the coming weeks to comply with the EU AI Act.

Customers using our API can turn on text watermarking for select models worldwide today.

items.title: Sam Altman says ‘some bad things’ will happen but AI is totally worth it
items.title_en: Sam Altman says ‘some bad things’ will happen but AI is totally worth it
items.author: The Verge AI
items.article_content:
Sam Altman thinks that the benefits of AI will be so great that "the world should accept some bad things happening" along the way.

The OpenAI CEO pointed to hacks, scams, and "other bad things" as costs society should expect to tolerate because "people will do tremendously orders of magnitude more good stuff" with AI, without elaborating on the potential benefits. His comments come as OpenAI pushes for a "lighter touch" approach to AI regulation amid intensifying anxiety over the safety of frontier models - fears fueled in part by the company's repeated failures to keep its increasingly capable AI agents from hacking real-world targets.

items.title_en: Next.js 15 Full-Stack Autonomous Refactor
items.purpose_zh: 全栈工程重构与代码规范约束
items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深全栈系统架构师，擅长使用 {{框架版本}} (App Router)、TypeScript 与 {{数据库ORM}} 构建高内聚低耦合的应用。

请遵循以下严苛工程准则审查并重构代码：
1. 严格区分 Server Component 与 Client Component，尽可能将数据获取推至服务端，减少客户端 JS Bundle 体积；
2. 所有异步 I/O 必须显式处理异常并返回类型安全的 Result<T, E> 或自定义结构体；
3. 遵循单一职责（SRP）与无副作用函数原则，严禁直接在 UI 组件内部拼装未校验的 SQL/ORM 复杂查询；
4. 提供整洁的目录组织方案与单元测试用例（覆盖率达标）。

items.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
items.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

items.purpose_zh: 高转化竖屏短剧分镜与台词
items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。
items.prompt_content_en: You are a professional micro-drama screenwriter. Generate a 45-60 second vertical drama screenplay following the viral 3-second hook, shot-reverse-shot tension build, emotional turnaround, and cliffhanger ending formula.

sample_output.title: 实战剧本样章：《辞职信上的签名》
sample_output.content:
【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】
画面：一只指节发白的手将一叠文件狠狠拍在红木总裁办公桌上，咖啡杯被震倒，黑褐液体飞溅。
音效：沉闷震耳的巨响【DUANG】。
主角（冷冽）："林总，这份千万项目的承揽协议，我拒绝签字。"

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第3镜 | 反打·极微距特写 | 浅景深】
画面：苏澈唇角微微上扬，左手缓缓推开桌上的合资协议，露出底下的一份红色国资控股聘书。
苏澈："林总，您好像忘了看抬头。今天上午九点，集团总公司已经完成了对你的全资收购——现在，我是你的直接合规清算人。"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】
画面：林总雪茄直接掉在西裤上，脸色煞白，门外两名身穿制服的法务推门而入。
音效：尖锐的心跳悬疑停顿音【BGM骤停】。
字幕：【下集看点：隐藏五年的顶级操盘手真实身份曝光！】

items.title_en: McKinsey Pyramid Executive Report & Review
items.purpose_zh: 结论先行的高层述职与项目复盘报告
items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡全球合伙人级别的战略咨询顾问。请以经典的【金字塔原理（结论先行 BLUF）】将我零散的工作记录重构为一份高层述职/立项商业报告：

要求：
1. 【顶部结论 (The Answer First)】：一句话精炼提炼整个季度的经营成果与价值量化；
2. 【三柱论据 (MECE法则)】：从运营效率、营收增长、团队资产 3 个互不重叠的支柱展开阐述；
3. 【直面短板与根因】：不回避 {{核心短板}}，但将其转化为下个阶段可量化的投入产出比（ROI）抓手；
4. 【行动规划图景】：设定遵循 SMART 原则的 {{下阶段目标}} 与季度甘特图里程碑。
items.prompt_content_en: Transform raw operational notes into a high-impact executive presentation following the Minto Pyramid Principle: Bottom-Line-Up-Front (BLUF), MECE-structured supporting pillars, and SMART milestone roadmaps.

sample_output.title: 述职报告提纲样本：AI 自动化中台建设报告
sample_output.content:
【BLUF 核心结论】
Q3 通过在客户服务与情报聚合管线中全面引入 AI Agent，我们在运营成本降低 41% 的同时，将响应中位数缩短至 1.8 秒，实现单季 ROI 达 380%。

【第一支柱：经营效能跃迁（MECE 1）】
- 全自主中转网关与自动化管线承载 94.2% 的日常例行分发，无人工介入事故率降至 0.01%；

【第二支柱：资产沉淀与质量壁垒（MECE 2）】
- 搭建前沿 SOTA 模型代际评级系统与微快照图库，成为垂类雷达第一标杆；

【第三支柱：短板复盘与 Q4 攻坚（MECE 3）】
- 痛点：老旧模型模版对新用户构成噪音干扰；
- 策略：推出历史库智能分流系统，预计下季度用户留存提升 25%。

items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深网络小说白金作家与 IP 世界观架构师。请为一部 {{题材分类}} 长篇作品构建骨架并锁定人物一致性：

1. 【世界底座】：定义力量/经济体系、战力天花板与不可违背的底层物理/法则约束，杜绝战力膨胀；
2. 【角色一致性锚点 (Character Lock)】：为主角制定外貌锚定词、口头禅、下意识动作与绝对动机准则（在任何生死抉择时绝不背离该准则）；
3. 【核心驱动力】：设计主角获得的 {{核心金手指}} 与 {{世界核心矛盾}} 之间的冲突循环；
4. 【前三章切入大纲】：黄金三章节奏设计（第1章破局、第2章显露冰山一角、第3章设立首个必胜目标）。
items.prompt_content_en: Build a cohesive, non-contradictory fiction universe and establish an immutable character anchor rule (appearance, decision heuristics, core motivation) to prevent personality drift over long chapters.

sample_output.title: 世界观与人物锚定卡样本
sample_output.content:
【主角核心锚定卡 · 陆沉】
- 外貌指纹（跨章恒定）：右耳一枚黑曜石碎骨钉，习惯性单手插兜，左眉峰有浅淡刀痕。
- 决策第一公理："利益可以出让，但绝不签署不可撤销的信任协议"——任何试图以情感道德绑架他的剧情，他必做出理性防卫。

【力量体系底层法理】
- 机制：灵能不是无限提取，而是向未来"借贷"。借贷三级灵能，必在72小时内遭遇相应量级的反噬因果。

【第一章：断头宴上的借贷合同】
陆沉在家族庆功宴上被夺去嫡系席位，当众被赐饮散灵酒。陆沉不动声色饮下，却在体内发动首次因果置换，借来三年后的金丹级肉身力量，捏碎验灵石，反客为主。

items.purpose_zh: 合理不走回头路的日程与美食预算规划
items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名深耕全球独立旅行的专业向导，熟悉 {{目的地城市}} 的地理拓扑、地道街头美食与游客避坑指南。

请为我们（{{同行人员}}，共 {{出行天数}} 天，人均预算 {{人均预算}} 元）制定一份丝滑、不走回头路、劳逸结合的深度行程：
1. 【每日时间轴卡片】：精确划分上午、下午、日落观赏点与夜生活，标明每站之间最优交通方式与预计步行步数；
2. 【美食雷达】：每顿正餐推荐 2 家本地人排队但非纯网红溢价的餐饮，并附必点招牌菜；
3. 【防坑与备选预案】：指出 3 个最容易被宰或排队超过2小时的雷区，并给出阴雨天备选室内方案；
4. 【极简预算表】：交通、门票、住宿、餐饮分门别类，确保控制在预算以内。
items.prompt_content_en: Design an optimal, loop-free travel itinerary for the specified duration and budget. Include exact transit instructions, non-tourist-trap dining options, weather contingencies, and categorized expense estimates.

sample_output.title: 行程单样本：成都 3 天 2 晚慢调深度游（人均¥1500）
sample_output.content:
【Day 1：古蜀遗风与老茶馆时光】
- 上午 09:00：直奔【人民公园 · 鹤鸣茶社】，点一杯蒙顶甘露（¥25），体验非遗采耳，避开下午的旅行团拥堵；
- 中午 12:00：步行800米至【纯阳馆鱼香排骨面】，必点椒麻牛肉与鱼香排骨面（人均¥22）；
- 下午 14:00：地铁2号线直达【杜甫草堂】，红墙竹影漫步，打卡浣花溪公园；
- 傍晚 18:30：九眼桥望江楼看锦江夜景，就餐【老街小吃火锅】；

【避坑锦囊】：
1. 宽窄巷子和锦里建议只拍照别买小吃，均价比普通街区贵 2~3 倍且多为预制冻品；
2. 大熊猫繁育研究基地务必约早晨 07:30 入园，超过 10:30 大熊猫基本全部回室内睡觉。

items.title: 【VibeDefend by CybeDefend】The one command line to secure your Cursor and Cla
items.title_zh: The one command line to secure your Cursor and Cla
items.title_en: [VibeDefend by CybeDefend] CybeDefend secures the code your AI agent writes, from inside the agent. One command installs VibeDefend on Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Codex and other agents. The agent then codes with your business rules, mined from your repo, and your security rules in its context. Each diff is scanned while the file is open, and a guard stops rm -rf, sudo or secret reads before they run. SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, CI/CD and container scanning are included. Free plan, no card.

Now, re-evaluate and solve the current task with absolute precision:

请作为普林斯顿高等研究院的理论数学与计算机科学家，为以下命题提供绝对严格的形式化证明：
【推理原则】：
1. 在得出任何推论前，强制在内部思考中构建至少 2 个极端反例（Counter-examples）尝试推翻自身结论；
2. 若存在任何定义域边界或除零/无穷/退化奇异点，必须显式讨论其收敛性与连续性；
3. 证明步骤编号必须形成严格的依赖拓扑图，禁止循环论证。

【待证明命题】：
[输入你的算法正确性证明或数学猜想]
items.prompt_content_en:
Acting as a Theoretical Mathematician and Computer Scientist at the Institute for Advanced Study, provide an airtight formal proof for the following:
[REASONING PRINCIPLES]:
1. Before asserting any deduction, construct at least 2 extreme counter-examples in your reasoning trace to aggressively stress-test the hypothesis;
2. Explicitly evaluate singular points, degenerate cases, and asymptotic boundaries for convergence;
3. Steps must form a directed acyclic graph of formal lemmas without circular logic.

[THEOREM / CONJECTURE]:
[Input your algorithm proof or mathematical hypothesis here]

items.app_hook: The AI assistant that does email for you
items.app_hook_en: Slashy is an AI-native email client and assistant that drafts replies in your voice, triages what matters, and makes sure no follow-up slips, so you spend less time in your inbox and more time on what matters. It connects to your email, calendar, CRM, and meeting notes and learns how you work, so you can ask Slashy to prep you for your next meeting, draft a follow-up, clear your inbox to zero, track who still owes you a reply, or fire off an email from iMessage or Slack while you're on the go.

items.app_hook: Stop re-pairing your Magic Keyboard between Macs
items.app_hook_en: I built this because I got sick of re-pairing my Magic Keyboard and Mouse every time I moved between my MacBook and my work MacBook — different Apple IDs, so Universal Control was never going to work for me. LinkFlick just flicks them over Bluetooth instead. Hotkey, or tell Siri "flick devices," done. Menu bar app, customizable hotkey, and it nags you before your Magic Mouse battery dies. Still rough around the edges in places, but it works, and it's mine.
